evidence.transcript: Timestamped user-supplied transcript with censored words and potential ASR mistakes; source of semantic joke analysis.
evidence.visual: Earlier frame inspections verified counter, mimic fights, math graphic, broadcast reset and outro. Other gameplay context is drawn from transcript and should be marked accordingly.
evidence.audio: Earlier numeric RMS/time inspection; transcript includes [Music] at several moments. No human- or model-confirmed ear-based semantic/prosodic listening completed.
limitations: Transcript does not prove vocal intonation or laughter.
Caption misspellings such as dessert/deserter, knight/Kigot and censored profanity require spot validation.
Transcript word timestamps approximate; frame-accurate edit timings require revisiting source video.
Do not infer creator intent from a single example.

thesis: A hostile gothic-horror game supplies sincere fear and repeated punishment; narrator turns threats into banal social complaints, fear into polite refusal, triumph into self-humiliation, and recurring enemies into comic story arcs. Sparse semantically matched visual/music interventions complete spoken jokes.

persona_axes.relationship_to_world: Terrified participant who insists on giving enemies mundane personalities
persona_axes.relationship_to_self: Boastful antihero repeatedly corrected by gameplay; laughs at his own bad decisions
persona_axes.humor_edge: Adult, profane, transgressive; not necessary to replicate literally when adapting to a new channel
persona_axes.game_atmosphere: Preserve grim seriousness as straight man; do not overlay humor nonstop
persona_axes.voice_prosody: Actual vocal intonation and dynamics not verified; transcript supports rhetorical style, not measured performance

chapter_structure.label: Cold open and comic persona
chapter_structure.function: Establish blasphemous irreverence, mocking narration, self-contradictory confidence, loot riffs.

chapter_structure.label: Dragon threat and disappointing risk
chapter_structure.function: Introduce overwhelming threat, panic, absurd comparison, loot anticlimax.

chapter_structure.label: Knight pursuit and failed schemes
chapter_structure.function: Evasion and mockery become running gag; weaponize dragon unsuccessfully.

chapter_structure.label: Mimic betrayal and second death
chapter_structure.function: Introduce secondary recurring nemesis; betrayal, despair and failed revenge.

chapter_structure.label: Knight escalates, reverses, resolves
chapter_structure.function: Ongoing chase, mistaken dragon cheese, then edited heroic music and anticlimactic victory.

chapter_structure.label: Mimic grudge resolved and loot pun
chapter_structure.function: Pay off mimic recurrence; reward has its own wordplay.

chapter_structure.label: Distinct outro
chapter_structure.function: Shock-comedy outro; not representative of gameplay narration pacing.

semantic_beats.title: Blasphemous cold open
semantic_beats.transcript_excerpt: Your Lord has blessed you... Rejoice.
semantic_beats.gameplay_context: Player interrupts an ominous church encounter.
semantic_beats.joke_mechanism: Sacred/profane collision: turns solemn religion and gothic horror into deliberately outrageous praise.
semantic_beats.editor_function: Keep the gothic setting intact; let verbal sacrilege cause the tonal whiplash. Short broadcast interruption around 0:11.
semantic_beats.voice_function: Mock reverence, transgressive exaggeration; exact prosody unverified

semantic_beats.title: Rolling joke reverses itself
semantic_beats.transcript_excerpt: What am I, a child after a bag of Halloween candy? ... I've never felt so alive.
semantic_beats.gameplay_context: Player discovers rolling/evasive movement.
semantic_beats.joke_mechanism: Dismissively rejects a simple game mechanic, then immediately enthusiastically endorses it.
semantic_beats.editor_function: Retain both sides of the reversal and the gameplay demonstrating the mechanic.
semantic_beats.voice_function: Performative disdain turns to delighted admission

semantic_beats.title: Enemy as underpaid employee
semantic_beats.transcript_excerpt: I don't know what they're paying that guy... it's definitely not enough. ... Those boxes sure had it coming.
semantic_beats.gameplay_context: Guard seems unaware or preoccupied with destructible objects.
semantic_beats.joke_mechanism: Humanize the AI enemy as an underpaid worker; sarcastically congratulate irrelevant activity.
semantic_beats.editor_function: Leave enough visual context to show what enemy is doing before the final line.

semantic_beats.title: Deserter trousers extended wordplay
semantic_beats.transcript_excerpt: Ooh, [deserter] trousers. ... sexy [deserter] look ... fat pants all day.
semantic_beats.gameplay_context: Player loots deserter trousers. User-supplied transcript renders "dessert"; game item is deserter trousers.
semantic_beats.joke_mechanism: Escalating pun/semantic riff: item name becomes a fashion premise then an absurd lifestyle argument.
semantic_beats.editor_function: Keep the item pickup legible while the riff unfolds; no unrelated cutaways necessary.
semantic_beats.voice_function: Mock excitement followed by ridiculous rationalization

semantic_beats.title: Combat has no timeouts
semantic_beats.transcript_excerpt: Who told this guy he could drink his Kool-Aid right now? ... there are no timeouts.
semantic_beats.gameplay_context: Enemy attempts to drink a healing consumable during combat.
semantic_beats.joke_mechanism: Pop-culture crossover reframes a standard game mechanic as a rule violation; narrator heckles enemy.
semantic_beats.editor_function: Show the healing animation and retaliatory hits.

semantic_beats.title: Third hit dare backfires
semantic_beats.transcript_excerpt: I bet you can't do it a third time. Oh... there you go.
semantic_beats.gameplay_context: Enemy lands another strike while narrator is issuing a challenge.
semantic_beats.joke_mechanism: Challenge → instant contradiction → conceding punchline.
semantic_beats.editor_function: Avoid cutting away before the counterexample lands.
semantic_beats.voice_function: Taunting turns to a panicked concession

semantic_beats.title: Dragon intrudes on stealth fantasy
semantic_beats.transcript_excerpt: I wonder if I can Assassin's Creed these guys... It's just a gigantic ... dragon.
semantic_beats.gameplay_context: Unexpected enormous dragon disrupts attempted stealth/attack.
semantic_beats.joke_mechanism: A mundane action plan is interrupted by a colossal, wildly disproportionate new threat.
semantic_beats.editor_function: Preserve the discovery and shock; do not preannounce the dragon with a narrator caption.
semantic_beats.voice_function: Surprise turns into exaggeratedly calm description

semantic_beats.title: Impossible comparison
semantic_beats.transcript_excerpt: I'd have an easier time overthrowing North Korea with a pencil.
semantic_beats.gameplay_context: Narrator sees the dragon as likely impossible to beat.
semantic_beats.joke_mechanism: Wildly disproportionate absurd comparison dramatizes perceived difficulty.
semantic_beats.editor_function: Let the actual size/strength of dragon sell the comparison.
semantic_beats.voice_function: Hyperbole rather than literal political claim

semantic_beats.title: Dragon needs therapy
semantic_beats.transcript_excerpt: Serves them right... ignoring the... dragon. ... little problem with personal space.
semantic_beats.gameplay_context: Nearby enemies do not react in the expected way to dragon.
semantic_beats.joke_mechanism: Treat the monster as a socially inconsiderate person, while mocking NPC obliviousness.
semantic_beats.editor_function: Show dragon/NPC relationship; preserve threat under commentary.

semantic_beats.title: Fear punctures curiosity
semantic_beats.transcript_excerpt: Oh my god... Does fire hurt? ... Fire definitely hurts just like in real life.
semantic_beats.gameplay_context: Dragon breathes fire and narrator considers loot.
semantic_beats.joke_mechanism: Escalating fear/vocal repetition resolves in absurdly obvious empirical conclusion.
semantic_beats.editor_function: Keep fear beat, fire impact and dry conclusion in same sequence.
semantic_beats.voice_function: Rapid alarm followed by deadpan observation; cadence inferred from wording only

semantic_beats.title: The club is not worth the burns
semantic_beats.transcript_excerpt: I did this for a club? ... definitely worth every third-degree burn.
semantic_beats.gameplay_context: Dangerous excursion returns a mediocre weapon.
semantic_beats.joke_mechanism: Effort–reward mismatch; sarcastic praise reframes terrible reward as triumph.
semantic_beats.editor_function: Show the resource cost, pickup, and disparaging payoff.

semantic_beats.title: Strategic retreat from the knight
semantic_beats.transcript_excerpt: I decline. I respectfully decline your offer, sir.
semantic_beats.gameplay_context: Powerful knight pursues protagonist; player uses elevator/ladder to escape.
semantic_beats.joke_mechanism: Fear and cowardice euphemized as strategic choice or polite social refusal.
semantic_beats.editor_function: Retain frantic movement; optionally reduce edits during escape to maintain stakes.
semantic_beats.voice_function: Formal polite speech directly contradicts panicked action

semantic_beats.title: Knight deserves benefits
semantic_beats.transcript_excerpt: Somebody give this guy some benefits. I've seen corpses more motivated than that.
semantic_beats.gameplay_context: Knight persists in pursuit; narrator calls out enemy diligence.
semantic_beats.joke_mechanism: Running workplace metaphor; formidable menace becomes an overcommitted employee.
semantic_beats.editor_function: Hold on persistent pursuit before line, then resume danger.

semantic_beats.title: Dragon-backed taunt collapses
semantic_beats.transcript_excerpt: Only one of us doesn't have a dragon behind them. ... game just never lets me talk [trash].
semantic_beats.gameplay_context: Narrator attempts to threaten enemy by using dragon, gets hit mid-boast.
semantic_beats.joke_mechanism: Setup → instant contradiction → explicit admission that the game punishes bragging.
semantic_beats.editor_function: Keep boast, hit and acknowledgement contiguous; do not hide the embarrassing hit.

semantic_beats.title: Failed dragon cheese becomes deserved punishment
semantic_beats.transcript_excerpt: I want you to meet a friend of mine. ... Oh god, a dragon is still definitely there, you idiot. I deserve that.
semantic_beats.gameplay_context: Player tries to lure knight to dragon; self-endangers.
semantic_beats.joke_mechanism: Elaborate plan backfires; insults redirect from enemies to narrator himself.
semantic_beats.editor_function: Expose plan early enough that audience sees why it failed; retain self-blame.
semantic_beats.voice_function: Scheming to panicked insult to self-criticism

semantic_beats.title: Fighting inner demons
semantic_beats.transcript_excerpt: What is he fighting, his inner demons? You're going to lose that battle, buddy.
semantic_beats.gameplay_context: NPC behavior becomes an excuse for faux-psychological diagnosis.
semantic_beats.joke_mechanism: Personification of unsettling enemy AI as existentially troubled.
semantic_beats.editor_function: Show the peculiar NPC behavior that motivates the diagnosis.

semantic_beats.title: First mimic destroys trust
semantic_beats.transcript_excerpt: What in the actual... is that? ... Just chomp right down on my spine. ... trust issues.
semantic_beats.gameplay_context: Chest becomes a mimic, traps and kills player; death counter 13→14.
semantic_beats.joke_mechanism: Reward betrayal → horrifying slapstick → mundane relationship metaphor (trust issues).
semantic_beats.editor_function: Preserve loot expectation, transformation, grab, failed escape, deadpan aftermath and tally.
semantic_beats.voice_function: Alarm morphs into sarcastic permission then psychological understatement

semantic_beats.title: Everything is depressed; player dies too
semantic_beats.transcript_excerpt: Things could always be worse... Not today, dragon. ... maybe today... Life is meaningless. And then you die.
semantic_beats.gameplay_context: Narrator mocks hostile world’s hopelessness; attempts to escape dragon and reconsiders.
semantic_beats.joke_mechanism: Depression as a repeated absurd descriptor, immediate self-contradiction by fresh danger, fatalistic philosophy.
semantic_beats.editor_function: Preserve progression from concern to jinx; let tragedy and nihilistic joke coexist.

semantic_beats.title: Equation completes a spoken joke
semantic_beats.transcript_excerpt: If you divided anything by the number of [cares] he gives, we'd be in a lot of trouble.
semantic_beats.gameplay_context: Knight ignores or does not react to narrator; oversized division by zero graphic appears around 5:37.
semantic_beats.joke_mechanism: Idiomatic zero concern is literalized as division by zero. Graphics are semantically motivated, not random.
semantic_beats.editor_function: Show or animate the zero denominator exactly on the linguistic reveal; keep it brief.

semantic_beats.title: Second mimic: planned revenge becomes worse
semantic_beats.transcript_excerpt: Fool me once... Fool me twice... I don't want a hug from you... kicked me into a new dimension.
semantic_beats.gameplay_context: Narrator revisits mimic and dies again; counter 14→15.
semantic_beats.joke_mechanism: Revenge bravado → grotesque threat reframed as unwanted hug → ridiculous martial-arts attribution → fresh death.
semantic_beats.editor_function: Connect to earlier mimic to preserve callback; avoid compressing to a generic loss montage.

semantic_beats.title: Existential skeletons and opting out
semantic_beats.transcript_excerpt: Full of existential skeletons. ... How about try no battle?
semantic_beats.gameplay_context: Player encounters hostile environment and a note recommending ranged combat.
semantic_beats.joke_mechanism: The fantasy game demands heroism; narrator treats avoidance as superior strategy.
semantic_beats.editor_function: Show advice and deliberate rejection rather than randomly cutting to flight.

semantic_beats.title: Knight breaks ladder escape fantasy
semantic_beats.transcript_excerpt: Good luck climbing down the ladder... Oh... he did it.
semantic_beats.gameplay_context: Persistent knight follows player down ladder.
semantic_beats.joke_mechanism: Taunt rests on false confidence in game mechanics; instant reversal creates joke.
semantic_beats.editor_function: Leave ladder descent visible for payoff; do not pre-cut the counterexample.
semantic_beats.voice_function: Superior tone breaks into shocked respect

semantic_beats.title: Dragon trap boomerangs
semantic_beats.transcript_excerpt: It's a little warm, but you'll get over it... isn't that just the greatest ... thing? I got my head barbecued.
semantic_beats.gameplay_context: Player tries to lure knight into dragon fire but gets burned to death; counter reaches 16.
semantic_beats.joke_mechanism: Setup of cruel trick → cruel reversal directed at protagonist → exaggerated sarcastic gratitude.
semantic_beats.editor_function: Maintain spatial relation between lure and flame; brief reset card around 7:21.
semantic_beats.voice_function: Feigned reassurance followed by bitter sarcasm

semantic_beats.title: Future editor becomes character
semantic_beats.transcript_excerpt: All right, future me. Cue the battle music.
semantic_beats.gameplay_context: After repeated avoidance, narrator finally commits to fighting knight; transcript marks music ~7:33.
semantic_beats.joke_mechanism: Explicit fourth-wall break calls editing into the joke; music supplies ceremonial self-importance.
semantic_beats.editor_function: Music must begin in response to spoken cue, not before; modulate seriousness against actual encounter.

semantic_beats.title: Victory makes prior cowardice funnier
semantic_beats.transcript_excerpt: That wasn't so bad. ... I could have just taken him on this whole time. Serves me right.
semantic_beats.gameplay_context: Knight is defeated after prolonged avoidance.
semantic_beats.joke_mechanism: Delayed payoff recontextualizes ~minutes of running as unnecessary; narrator himself closes the joke.
semantic_beats.editor_function: Allow short victorious beat, then self-own; keep continuity with earlier knight chase.

semantic_beats.title: Another disappointing pickup
semantic_beats.transcript_excerpt: Better be something good up here... Yes, that definitely works. ... considered this good.
semantic_beats.gameplay_context: Player expects worthwhile reward after knight fight.
semantic_beats.joke_mechanism: An apparently disappointing reward is greeted with emphatic ironic positivity.
semantic_beats.editor_function: Sync loot reveal and sarcastic response; quality of loot should be visually legible.

semantic_beats.title: Third encounter with the mimic
semantic_beats.transcript_excerpt: Round three, you disgusting spawn of Satan... nobody will miss this thing.
semantic_beats.gameplay_context: Narrator returns to mimic for third try and eventually kills it.
semantic_beats.joke_mechanism: Recurring antagonist upgrades from surprise to grudge to revenge payoff.
semantic_beats.editor_function: Retain round marker, partial fight, victory moment; incorporate earlier losses as narrative memory.

semantic_beats.title: Deep Battle Axe becomes an emo character
semantic_beats.transcript_excerpt: This axe is so deep. Nobody really understands him. It's just not part of the system.
semantic_beats.gameplay_context: Mimic drops Deep Battle Axe.
semantic_beats.joke_mechanism: Literalizes descriptor "deep" as melodramatic teenage psychology; reward riff closes the revenge arc.
semantic_beats.editor_function: Hold item acquisition and name long enough for wordplay.
semantic_beats.voice_function: Deadpan fake empathy with the weapon

semantic_beats.title: Outrageous outro and self-directed insult
semantic_beats.transcript_excerpt: Handcrafted... 3D recreation... I should know I'm a massive...
semantic_beats.gameplay_context: Video transitions to branded outro.
semantic_beats.joke_mechanism: Transgressive adult shock joke closed by speaker-directed insult rather than triumph.
semantic_beats.editor_function: Keep outro thematically separate; do not transplant creator-specific joke or assets.
semantic_beats.voice_function: Mock expert demonstration undercut by self-deprecation

reusable_patterns.name: Terror versus banal social complaint
reusable_patterns.rule: Preserve atmospheric gameplay; reinterpret monster behavior as an everyday social failing (bad manners, poor work conditions, etc.)
reusable_patterns.guardrail: Humor must depend on observed behavior; no context-free one-liners.

reusable_patterns.name: Confidence punished in under five seconds
reusable_patterns.trigger: Player makes a taunt, confident prediction, or dismissive claim
reusable_patterns.rule: Keep unbroken boast → contradictory gameplay → short acknowledgement of error.
reusable_patterns.guardrail: Do not fabricate gameplay timing; retain genuine outcomes.

reusable_patterns.name: Fear expressed as bureaucratic politeness
reusable_patterns.trigger: Player retreats or refuses a dangerous encounter
reusable_patterns.rule: Pair frantic movement with calm, formal verbal refusal or rationalization.

reusable_patterns.name: Loot and expectation anticlimax
reusable_patterns.trigger: Player risks death to obtain underwhelming loot
reusable_patterns.rule: Show cost and reward, then offer overenthusiastic or defeated commentary.
reusable_patterns.guardrail: Ground joke in item value/usefulness where possible.

reusable_patterns.name: Literalize spoken idiom visually
reusable_patterns.trigger: Narrator makes a comparison with a concrete symbolic form
reusable_patterns.rule: On linguistic climax, insert brief graphic that illustrates the actual meaning.
examples: dividing by zero on number of cares
reusable_patterns.guardrail: Never add mathematical or other effects at random.

reusable_patterns.name: Recurring nemesis carries the B-story
reusable_patterns.rule: Preserve first encounter, second failure/escalation, third successful or failed resolution; attach narrative memory.
reusable_patterns.guardrail: A callback must refer to a real prior event.

reusable_patterns.name: Overreaching simile
reusable_patterns.trigger: Threat or difficulty is unusually disproportionate
reusable_patterns.rule: Use one unexpected analogy then return quickly to unembellished action.
reusable_patterns.guardrail: Avoid copying creator-specific similes; write originals.

reusable_patterns.name: Meta editor collaboration
reusable_patterns.trigger: Player knowingly addresses edit or future self
reusable_patterns.rule: Treat the spoken editing instruction as setup; time music/SFX to fulfill it.
reusable_patterns.guardrail: Never let editor music preempt the joke.

reusable_patterns.name: Humanize AI and objects
reusable_patterns.trigger: NPC behaves oddly or loot item name has a double meaning
reusable_patterns.rule: Give an enemy/object mundane personality, existential worries or occupational motives.
reusable_patterns.guardrail: Tie the trait to an actual observation or name.

reusable_patterns.name: Panic → mundane understatement
reusable_patterns.rule: Let reaction hit; end with remarkably ordinary or polite response.
reusable_patterns.guardrail: Do not force sarcastic response into moments requiring quiet.

reusable_patterns.name: Failure scoreboard without overcutting
reusable_patterns.trigger: A meaningful actual death or failure
reusable_patterns.rule: Keep natural gameplay; let restrained tally update function as unsentimental narrative memory.
reusable_patterns.guardrail: Avoid treating every change in camera as an edited cut.

reusable_patterns.name: Fearful antihero instead of power fantasy
reusable_patterns.trigger: Confrontation where escape may be sensible
reusable_patterns.rule: Make avoidance itself into a protagonist preference, then let consequences contradict the plan.
reusable_patterns.guardrail: Keep agency and progression; do not make whole video only avoidance.

reusable_patterns.name: Black-comedy philosophy
reusable_patterns.trigger: World appears relentlessly miserable or hostile
reusable_patterns.rule: Make despair/existentialism a darkly ironic character trait of the setting, coupled with speaker self-awareness.
examples: life is meaningless and then you die
reusable_patterns.guardrail: Use situation-driven fictional dark humor, not automatic cruelty to real people.

reusable_patterns.name: Premise extension (three-step riff)
reusable_patterns.trigger: New noun or situation allows a word association
reusable_patterns.rule: Introduce the hook; expand its implications; end with absurd consequence or self-directed undercut.
reusable_patterns.guardrail: Do not spend multiple sentences riffing unless action allows it.

timeline_alignment.audio_envelope_notes: Earlier measured quieter test-card interruption and stronger impact peaks around mimic deaths; this is acoustic dynamics, not verified sarcasm delivery.

detect: Player boasts within seconds of failure
NPC seems oblivious, idle or excessively persistent
player speaks an idiom with visualizable content
editing_automation_recipe.retrieve: Match a detected event sequence to a generalized pattern, not a specific creator catchphrase or copyrighted asset.
editing_automation_recipe.plan: Reserve unedited setup and game atmosphere, then pick one strong spoken punchline, an optional synchronized effect and a short aftermath.
editing_automation_recipe.timeline_output: Store clip in/out, transcript quote and confidence, referenced prior callback IDs, edit timing offsets, music ducking, SFX and editable project path.
editing_automation_recipe.review: Reject invented causal connections, inauthentic voice imitation, unrelated stock memes, and jokes the gameplay does not support.

source_attribution: Use as study of general techniques; produce new writing and own voice, audio and graphics when reusing patterns.
